chapter: Building the band in New York
title: Rehearsing at the Woodside and creating a theme together
summary: Basie says the band rehearsed a lot in New York, in the Woodside basement, making up themes at the piano and working them out together.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
